speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Micturition Syncope (Reflex Syncope).

The ECG and metabolic panel are normal, ruling out cardiac arrhythmias and metabolic causes. Your loss of consciousness immediately after urination, combined with a quick recovery and lack of confusion, is highly characteristic of vasovagal syncope triggered by bladder emptying.
